title: Rollback edge-case testing matrix (batching/caching/quantization)
linked_artifacts: PR: redwood/pr-10479 (runtime apply locking + propagation status)
content:
Context / purpose
- This matrix is the runtime-focused test plan for the “Safe apply + rollback mechanism” project.
- Goal: enumerate edge cases when toggling optimization knobs (batching, caching, quantization profiles) and validate that:
  (1) Apply is safe (no split-brain, predictable rollout semantics)
  (2) Rollback to any prior known-good version is fast + reversible
  (3) Runtime behavior is correct under load (no correctness regressions, controlled warmup/caching behaviors)

Scope of testing
- Targets: Hosted + Dedicated + Private semantics are similar, but execution environments differ.
- Runtime areas covered: continuous batching, scheduler knobs, KV/prefix caching, cache invalidation, quantization profile swaps, warmup behavior, and in-flight request handling.
- Not included: “partial rollback” of individual fields (initial release is whole-config rollback).

Test environments / setup
- Primary: rt-staging-2 (H100), rt-staging-1 (A100) + synthetic load generator (chat + completion mix).
- Optional: private-lab-airgap (offline validation for Private packaging constraints).
- Workloads:
  - Chat: 70% (llama3-70b-instruct class) @ 1–4k prompt tokens, 256–1024 gen tokens
  - Completion: 20% (mixtral class) @ 1–8k prompt tokens, 128–512 gen tokens
  - Embeddings: 10% (embedding model) to ensure cache keys/telemetry not impacted by chat config
- Standard load levels:
  - L1: 30% GPU util steady state
  - L2: 60% GPU util steady state
  - L3: 80% GPU util + burst (to trigger batching behavior)

What to record for every scenario (minimum)
- Identify:
  - scope (customer/region/cluster/route/model)
  - from_version -> to_version -> rollback_to_version
  - apply method: canary vs immediate
- Control plane / propagation:
  - config_version_id applied per runtime shard
  - propagation_status timeline (per shard) + any retries
  - lock/lease behavior: concurrent apply/rollback attempts should fail deterministically
- Runtime:
  - request correctness checks (golden prompts + output invariants)
  - p50/p95/p99 latency, TTFT, tokens/s, error rate (429/5xx/timeouts)
  - GPU memory footprint, KV cache hit rate, batch size distribution
- Auditability (spot-check): apply_attempted/applied/failed and rollback_attempted/rolled_back/failed events exist with correlation ids

Acceptance criteria (runtime-centric)
- Rollback correctness:
  - No shard remains on the “bad” config after rollback completes (no split-brain). Tolerate transient mixed state only during propagation window.
  - In-flight requests either complete successfully under the config they started with OR are safely retried (no partial output corruption).
- Safety:
  - Cache invalidation behavior matches the knob semantics (no serving stale incompatible cache entries).
  - Quantization swaps do not silently produce wrong outputs (numerical instability should surface as validation failures).
- Operational:
  - Rollback execution time fits on-call constraints (target: < 5 min for single-scope route; < 15 min for multi-cluster scope).

Matrix legend
- Knobs referenced (examples):
  - batching.max_batch_size, batching.max_wait_ms, batching.continuous_enabled
  - cache.prefix_cache_enabled, cache.kv_cache_policy, cache.invalidation_mode
  - quant.profile (fp16, int8, int4), quant.calibration_id
  - scheduler.admission_control_enabled, scheduler.max_concurrent_requests
- Validation signals:
  - Metrics: request_latency_ms{p95}, request_errors_total, gpu_oom_total, kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_size_histogram
  - Rollout: config_apply_success_total, config_apply_failure_total, config_apply_duration_ms, config_propagation_stuck
  - Logs: runtime_config_hash, config_version_id, cache_epoch, quant_profile_loaded


TESTING MATRIX (table)

Columns:
ID | Category | Change (vN) | Rollback target | Preconditions | Steps | Expected runtime behavior | What to validate (metrics/logs) | Common failure mode to watch | Notes/mitigation | Owner

RT-01 | Batching | Increase batching.max_batch_size 16 -> 64 | rollback to vN-1 | L2 load, continuous batching ON | (1) Apply vN canary 10% (2) ramp 100% (3) rollback | Higher throughput, slight TTFT increase; no OOM; rollback returns batch distribution to prior | batch_size_histogram shift, gpu_mem_used stable, p95 latency within gates; config_version_id converges | OOM spikes at L3; queueing -> timeouts | If OOM: rollback must invalidate any scheduler state that assumes new batch cap | Sofia

RT-02 | Batching | Decrease batching.max_wait_ms 10ms -> 1ms | rollback to vN-1 | L1 load steady | Apply immediate (no canary), then rollback after 10 min | Lower tail latency possible; lower throughput; rollback restores throughput | tokens/s down then back up; p95 stable; no error increase | CPU overhead + scheduler thrash (micro-batches) | Preflight should warn if wait_ms too low for target QPS | Sofia

RT-03 | Batching | Toggle batching.continuous_enabled OFF -> ON | rollback to vN-1 | L2 w/ burst patterns | Apply vN, run burst test, rollback | During ON: smoother p95 under burst; rollback to OFF reverts batching behavior; no stuck queues | request_latency_ms p95 under burst; queue_depth; batch_size variance; config_apply_duration | “Stuck” microbatch loop causing elevated TTFT | Watch for regression where continuous batching ON + rollback leaves scheduler flag inconsistent across workers | Mateo

RT-04 | Batching/Scheduler | Tighten scheduler.max_concurrent_requests 1024 -> 256 | rollback to vN-1 | L3 (near saturation) | Apply vN canary 10% then 50%; rollback if 429s rise | More 429s expected; fewer timeouts; rollback restores acceptance | 429 rate up then back down; timeout rate down; admission_control logs | Gate mismatch: rollback may “recover” but queues remain drained slowly | Ensure rollback also restores admission controller params + internal token bucket settings | Mateo

RT-05 | Cache | Enable cache.prefix_cache_enabled OFF -> ON | rollback to vN-1 | Repeated-prompt workload enabled | Apply vN, run replay test set, rollback | Cache hit rate increases; latency drops for repeats; rollback disables hits (hit rate returns to baseline); correctness unaffected | kv_cache_hit_rate/prefix_hit_rate; request_latency p50; cache_epoch increments appropriately | Serving stale prefix entries after rollback due to shared cache namespace | Namespacing requirement: cache key must include config_version_id or cache_epoch; rollback increments epoch | Omar

RT-06 | Cache | Change cache.invalidation_mode lazy -> eager | rollback to vN-1 | Prefix cache already ON | Apply vN and roll forward; observe warmup; rollback | Eager invalidation triggers temporary latency bump; rollback restores lazy behavior; no error spikes | latency bump magnitude/duration; cache_evictions_total; cache_epoch; “warming” logs | Thundering herd during eager warmup; rollback may cause second herd | Mitigate by canary + warmup rate limit; ensure rollback does not double-invalidate without backoff | Omar

RT-07 | Cache/KV | Switch kv_cache_policy “reuse” -> “strict” (no cross-request reuse) | rollback to vN-1 | Chat workload L2 | Apply vN, run correctness (goldens), rollback | Lower risk of contamination; higher memory churn; rollback returns reuse; no correctness diff | gpu_mem_alloc churn; kv_cache_evictions; output invariants | Hidden correctness bug: reuse policy rollback leaves residual KV entries referenced | Require kv cache epoch bump on policy change + rollback; validate no invalid pointer use in logs | Noah

RT-08 | Quantization | quant.profile fp16 -> int8 | rollback to fp16 | Model supports int8 kernels; calibration_id available | Apply vN canary 10%; run golden eval; ramp; rollback | Memory down, throughput up; small quality delta allowed by gates; rollback restores quality; no crash | gpu_mem_used drop; tokens/s up; golden eval pass rate; kernel_loaded=int8 then fp16 | Quant kernel load failure on some shards -> mixed precision split brain | Ensure apply is atomic per shard and rollback handles partial load (unload/reload) | Noah

RT-09 | Quantization | quant.profile int8 -> int4 | rollback to int8 | L1 then L2 | Apply vN canary; run long-context tests; rollback | Possible quality regression esp. long context; rollback should be fast and deterministic | long-context golden checks; p95 latency; error rate; “quant_profile_loaded” logs | Numerical instability or NaNs; rollback leaves int4 kernels resident | Verify kernel unload path; ensure rollback triggers full model reload where required | Noah

RT-10 | Quantization | Change quant.calibration_id A -> B (same profile) | rollback to A | calibration bundles exist | Apply vN; run eval; rollback | Minimal perf change; quality change possible; rollback restores outputs | golden diff threshold; audit log shows calibration_id | Cache contamination: old prefix cache reused across calibration swap | Force cache epoch bump on calibration_id changes; verify hit rate resets appropriately | Omar

RT-11 | Quant + Cache | Enable prefix cache + switch fp16->int8 in same config version | rollback to previous config | Workload with repeats + L2 | Apply vN; run mixed tests; rollback | Cache keys must include quant profile; rollback must not reuse incompatible cached prefixes | prefix_hit_rate; output invariants; cache_key_version logs | Wrong outputs due to cross-quant cached prefixes | Hard requirement: cache namespace includes (model_id, quant_profile, calibration_id, config_version_id/epoch) | Omar

RT-12 | Runtime warmup | Increase warmup.requests_per_shard 50 -> 200 | rollback to 50 | Can trigger on apply | Apply vN; observe apply time; rollback | Longer apply window; runtime remains responsive; rollback reduces warmup time next apply | config_apply_duration_ms; request errors during apply; warmup logs | Apply “stuck” because warmup competes with live traffic | Warmup must be deprioritized during L3; rollback should cancel in-progress warmup job | Mateo

RT-13 | Failure mode | Partial propagation during apply (simulate 30% shards fail to fetch config) | rollback to known-good | Induce network faults to subset | Apply vN, confirm mixed; invoke rollback | Rollback should converge all shards to rollback target; failed shards should recover via retry | propagation_status timeline; config_version_id convergence; apply/rollback failure counters | “Split-brain” persists due to stuck lock or retry storm | Verify lease expiry + retry backoff; rollback should supersede apply in control-plane ordering | Mateo

RT-14 | Failure mode | Concurrent apply + rollback attempts (two operators) | rollback to previous | RBAC enabled; two sessions | Start apply vN; immediately attempt rollback from another session | One operation wins; other receives conflict w/ clear error; no deadlocks | API response codes; lock owner logs; audit events for both attempts | Lock not released -> stuck applies | Ensure lock includes scope key + TTL; audit must record denied/conflict attempts | Rafael

RT-15 | Scheduler/Batching | Change batching.max_batch_size AND scheduler.max_concurrent_requests (risk: oscillation) | rollback to previous | L2->L3 ramp | Apply vN; run saturation test; rollback | No oscillation in queue depth; rollback restores stable queue behavior | queue_depth; p95 latency; admission_control decisions | “Sawtooth” latency from conflicting knobs; rollback leaves scheduler in degraded state | Validator should warn on combos; include runtime invariant checks post-apply and post-rollback | Sofia

RT-16 | Canary gates | Canary apply 10% with metric gate triggered (p95 latency +20%) then rollback | rollback to known-good | Configure gate thresholds | Apply vN canary; trigger gate fail; auto-stop (no auto-rollback); manual rollback | Canary stops at 10%; rollback returns canary shards too; system stable | gate evaluation logs; canary_percent; config_version_id | Canary shards keep “bad” config after stop | Ensure stop action is explicit (halt rollout) and rollback is a separate action; both converge | Jada

RT-17 | Long context | Increase batching settings under long-context heavy distribution | rollback to previous | 8k prompts majority | Apply vN; run long-context; rollback | No OOM; no cliff in TTFT; rollback restores prior | gpu_oom_total; ttft p95; attention kernel logs | Long context + larger batch -> OOM; rollback must free KV allocations promptly | Validate memory is actually released post-rollback; might require worker restart policy | Noah

RT-18 | Dedicated isolation | Apply/rollback scoped to a single Dedicated tenant route | rollback to prior | Dedicated cluster with two tenants (test) | Apply vN for tenant A only; rollback; confirm tenant B unaffected | Tenant A changes only; tenant B metrics stable; no cross-tenant cache bleed | tenant_id tagged metrics; cache namespace; config_version per tenant route | Shared cache pool causing cross-tenant contamination | Dedicated clusters should still include tenant scope in cache namespace; validate | Omar

RT-19 | Private offline | Private install: apply/rollback with limited connectivity (no external eval service) | rollback to previous | air-gapped lab | Apply vN using local validator only; rollback | Rollback works without cloud calls; audit logs retained locally | local audit log store; apply duration; runtime config hash | Validator hard-depends on external telemetry | Ensure “offline mode” preflight does schema + local invariants; gates optional | Leila

RT-20 | Idempotency | Retry rollback request with same idempotency key | rollback to vN-1 | Induce client timeout | Send rollback; timeout; resend same request | Exactly-once semantics; no duplicate events; stable final config | audit event dedupe; API idempotency logs; final config_version_id | Double rollback triggers extra cache invalidations | Validate idempotent handler returns same operation_id and does not bump cache_epoch twice | Chloe


Execution notes (how to run)
- Each scenario should be run twice:
  1) “Clean” run: no prior config churn in last 2h
  2) “Churn” run: after 5–10 version changes to stress history/propagation
- For quantization scenarios, always include a golden-prompt suite:
  - 50 short prompts, 30 medium, 20 long-context
  - Validate: no empty outputs, no repeated-token loops, no NaN/inf in logits (if available), and bounded divergence vs baseline
- For caching scenarios, always include:
  - replay set with identical prompts + prompts differing by 1 token
  - verify cache key segmentation (different quant/calibration/config_version should not hit)

Operational checks (on-call oriented)
- After rollback completes, confirm:
  - dashboards: p95 latency and error rate return to baseline within 10 min
  - runtime: config_version_id matches rollback target on all shards
  - cache: cache_epoch incremented when expected; no abnormal eviction storms
- If rollback does not converge in 5 min:
  - check for stuck lease/lock and escalate to Runtime (Mateo) + Control plane (Ethan)

Open questions / TODO
- Do we enforce “cache epoch bump” on every rollback by default, or only when cache-affecting fields changed?
  - runtime preference: bump on rollback if any of {prefix_cache_enabled, kv_cache_policy, quant.profile, calibration_id} differs.
- Quant swap correctness signal: do we have a cheap online sentinel (e.g., perplexity proxy) to gate canaries beyond golden prompts?
- Worker restart policy: for some quant profile changes, safest rollback may be “drain + restart” to guarantee kernel/memory cleanup.

Change log
- 2025-02-07: Added RT-13/RT-14 (propagation + concurrency), expanded cache namespace notes, added Private offline scenario.
- 2025-01-28: Added quant calibration_id scenarios and explicit cache epoch requirements.
- 2025-01-14: Initial matrix draft from runtime rollback thread + incident follow-ups.
